name: Integrate Klaviyo with Contact Form 7, Gravity Forms, WPForms and Elementor Forms
author: PluginsCafe

sections.description:
The Klaviyo Integration plugin empowers you to easily add or subscribe users to your Klaviyo lists straight from your WordPress forms. With built-in support for multiple top-tier form builders, you can ensure your email marketing campaigns are automatically populated without any manual data entry.

Supported Form Builders:
* Gravity Forms
* Contact Form 7 (CF7)
* WPForms
* Elementor Forms

Features:
* Subscribe users to any of your Klaviyo lists upon form submission.
* Map standard fields (Email, First Name, Last Name) directly to Klaviyo profiles.
* Simple and intuitive settings directly inside your form builder.
* Fully integrates with the official Klaviyo Lists API.

Important Notice:
To use this plugin, you will need a valid Klaviyo API key. By using this plugin and Klaviyo’s services, you agree to Klaviyo’s Legal, Terms, & Policies available here: https://www.klaviyo.com/legal.
sections.installation:
1. Install directly from your WordPress dashboard by uploading the plugin zip file, or extract the plugin folder into your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the newly created Klaviyo settings page in your dashboard.
  4. Enter your Klaviyo API Key (You can find or create one in your Klaviyo account: https://help.klaviyo.com/hc/en-us/articles/115005062267-Manage-Your-Account-s-API-Keys).
  5. Head to your preferred form builder (Gravity Forms, CF7, WPForms, or Elementor Forms), find the Klaviyo integration tab, and configure your lists and fields!

  • Improvement: Fixed text domain matching across the plugin.
  • Improvement: Minor UI/UX updates and bug fixes for more robust API processing.

1.0.0

  • Initial Release: Base integration for Gravity Forms.
